purpose: Full original-vocabulary exact JSON posterior, original marginals and sampling

scope: Pinned full MDLM original vocabulary (50258 including mask/control IDs); no topK or injected reference tokens; fixed original positions delta, EOS absent; rational normalized F64 softmax of one frozen step
operation: Return exact full valid mass, all original marginals, one exact sample; separately record mass+sample cost and exact rejection first sample, not compare rejected operation with mass/marginal API
comparison: Same rooted CNF parser, same common full lexical table including global refinement, fixed original frames and exact normalized rational probabilities. Global quotient competent, raw uses lexical memoization; no native EPIC mass comparison since it does not compute this law. Table/grammar/model startup recorded cold/prepared, shared forward and rational input conversion costs charged to each operation. No claim of full-generation timing from frozen inference. Position quotient refines only lexical-prefix reachable states at each physical slot; mandatory competent control. Count guards raised10x to avoid a capacity claim from a small chart budget; memory3GiB and whole-operation120s identical. Bidirectional controls use lexical forward/backward coaccessibility from ALL original choices and the actual fixed right suffix. Effects with unreachable next states become invalid in the per-position quotient. No grammar/gold/probability pruning; local and trimmed local are development candidates, choice fixed before independent capture. The independent predictive-stack control receives the same lexical trimming/local sums and primitive terminal coarsening, memoized deterministic grammar transitions, exact merging of arcs with equal target stacks, and safe necessary suffix terminal/closing-delimiter bounds. Its complete costs and original marginals are charged; no artificial depth ceiling.

success.correctness: Mass and all original marginal numerator vectors EXACTLY agree among every conclusive exact method. Samples satisfy strict UTF8 JSON and fixed original IDs; independent law oracles before model.
success.utility: At least20% median prepared operation wall AND CPU against ALL seven competent controls: six raw/global/per-position variants (original and bidirectional) plus deterministic predictive-stack inference, favorable sign every repetition, or localized additional capacity at equal limits. Other local variant is a retained ablation. Choose one candidate on development only; freeze before independent capture. Sampling separately against exact rejection; every loss/refusal retained.
success.confirmation: After strengthened development gate, all18 reused refinement documents (including6 original fresh captures, now explicitly seen); ALL5 new JSONTestSuite documents with nine rotations. Selected candidate fixed before new forwards. No outcome selection.
success.claims: No general theoretical novelty, semantic accuracy, whole-decoder speed, training, native EPIC superiority, human review or publication acceptance from this experiment.
